sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Use Làm ơn đưa tôi đến đồn cảnh sát. for "Please take me to the police station.". Làm ơn đưa tôi đến đồn cảnh sát.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Say Làm ơn đưa tôi đến đồn cảnh sát. for "Please take me to the police station.". Show the symptom, medicine, location, or helper contact if you can.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Nearby follow-ups: Call the police, Call an ambulance, and I lost my passport.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Best at a hotel desk, during a street help moment, or at a police counter, before the explanation gets long. Keep the location, passport copy, photo, injury, or helper contact close for the follow-up.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Use a steady voice and keep the request short. The goal is to help the other person understand the next safe step.
